{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values in customer_age
customer_age_missing = sales_df['customer_age'].isnull().sum()

# Check data type
dtype_age = sales_df['customer_age'].dtype

# Check for sentinel values (e.g., -1, 999, etc.)
sentinel_values = [999, -1, 0]  # common sentinel values
sentinel_count = sum(sales_df['customer_age'].isin(sentinel_values))

# Summary statistics
age_stats = sales_df['customer_age'].describe()

# Print results
customer_age_missing, dtype_age, sentinel_count, age_stats"}
